subject.title: [Bug]: Google Chat: Space/Group messages silently ignored (DMs work correctly)

question: Should this remain the canonical Google Chat Space mention-gating bug, or should maintainers consolidate it into a broader Google Chat Space/thread routing item before code work?
rationale: The classifier fix is already merged, but source plus reporter evidence show a remaining mention-gating/session-creation failure whose final boundary depends on live Google Chat annotation proof and maintainer consolidation choice.

options.title: Keep Canonical And Require Live Mention Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open for a Google Chat mention-detection fix with redacted live Space payload/probe proof and focused monitor-access coverage.

options.title: Consolidate Into A Broader Routing Item
options.body: Move the remaining requirement into a maintainer-selected Google Chat Space/thread routing issue and close this only after that canonical item clearly owns mentioned Space session creation.

options.title: Document Workaround Only
options.body: Treat `requireMention:false` plus restart guidance as the supported workaround, leaving mention detection behavior unchanged until stronger demand appears.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical And Require Live Mention Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a Google Chat mention-detection fix with redacted live Space payload/probe proof and focused monitor-access coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest inspected history in the current Google Chat policy/ingress path and can route the maintainer product boundary.
